jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.




Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.




Role Summary




We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team behind the surfaces that bring millions of people to Property Finder every month — search, property and location content, and the platforms that serve them across multiple countries and languages.

This is high-traffic, consumer-facing, and unusually unforgiving: page latency, cache behaviour, and data correctness are not just engineering quality metrics here, they directly move organic acquisition and revenue. You'll work close to the numbers and see the impact of your decisions in production within days.

It's a hands-on senior role. You'll design and own services end to end, influence architecture beyond your squad, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.




Key Responsibilities




Design, build, and operate the backend services powering our highest-traffic consumer surfaces.
Own your work end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and the follow-up iteration based on what production actually tells you.
Build new services and features in TypeScript (Node.js), and maintain and evolve our existing Go services.
Work at the edges of the system — caching, CDN behaviour, content delivery, and rendering paths — where small changes have outsized effects on cost and performance.
Build for multiple countries and languages from day one: content, localisation, and market-specific behaviour are the default, not an afterthought.
Partner with product, SEO, data, and web/mobile engineers to turn requirements into systems that stay maintainable after the first release.
Drive operational excellence: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability, latency, and infrastructure cost.
Mentor engineers, review designs and PRs properly, and shape our backend standards.




Desired Qualifications




Must have 5+ years of backend engineering, with significant time on high-traffic, consumer-facing systems.
Strong TypeScript (Node.js) — the primary language for all new work.
Go, or a track record that says you'll pick it up fast. Our existing production services are in Go and you'll own them alongside new development.
Experience designing and operating services in a distributed environment: API design, service boundaries, versioning, and inter-service communication — plus the judgement to know when not to split something.
Hands-on with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), caching (Redis), and search (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), including schema design, indexing, and query performance tuning under real load.
Production experience on AWS with containerised workloads, and genuine fluency in observability: metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, SLOs, and being on the hook when something breaks.




Additional Capabilities




Event-driven and asynchronous processing (Kafka, SQS, or similar).
Edge computing and CDN-level logic (Lambda@Edge, CloudFront), and multi-region considerations.

Job Description

Job Title: Solutions Engineer

Group: Solutions Engineering Team

Location: UAE

Company Overview

Quvia is the first AI-powered quality of experience (QoE) management platform for things that move, like ships and planes, transforming connectivity and digital experiences even in the most remote and hard-to-reach places. The Quvia platform uses AI and machine learning to seamlessly blend any combination of connectivity, regardless of provider, orbit or network, into one, vendor-neutral environment. It then delivers comprehensive, end-to-end analytics and dynamic network orchestration that optimizes for the best possible QoE and end-user experiences. Today, Quvia works with world-leading, Fortune 500 companies in aviation, cruise, shipping and more.

Why Quvia?


Founded in 2019, Quvia is a fast-growing, Series A tech startup passionate about making connectivity and digital experiences better for everyone, everywhere.
Our industry-first solutions are already addressing major challenges for companies in the aviation and cruise industries – and we're just getting started.
Quvia is headquartered in the greater Miami region, with offices in the UK and India, and remote teams around the world.
As an early-stage company, all Quvia employees have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our growth trajectory, and the future of the industries we serve.
Quvia is backed by Columbia Capital, a respected venture capital firm founded in 1989 that has raised over $5 Bn of fund commitments.


About The Role

The Solutions Engineer is the technical bridge between our customers and our engineering and operations teams, assessing a customer's current network, capturing new technical requirements and pain points, and converting them into solution designs that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will own the journey from qualification through proof of concept to production. This role demands deep networking fundamentals across terrestrial and satellite environments, hands-on expertise in software-defined networking (SDN) and multi-vendor SD-WAN technologies, scripting and DevOps capability, and the judgement to evaluate emerging technologies and design solutions that scale.

Working on this technology, you will have the opportunity to make a major impact on the implementation and quality of Quvia's next-generation products. Our environment cultivates innovation and rapid product iteration within a creative solution space, and we need a dedicated, organized, and efficient professional who thrives on being integral to a fast-paced startup. As an excellent communicator, you will set appropriate expectations, keep stakeholders apprised of progress and action items, manage project plans, balance workloads, and ensure we meet our commitments; all while navigating the complexities of large enterprise customers. Above all, you will think creatively through complex problems and design and implement solutions that address customer pain points and generate economic benefits, enabling us to publish a clear ROI for every customer.

What You’ll Do


Partner with sales to assess a customer’s current network, capture new technical requirements and pain points, and convert them into tailored solution designs with clear, measurable business outcomes.
Design, test and deploy multi path traffic orchestration systems across satellite, and terrestrial environments in customer networks using Quvia products and third party integrations. This will require the setup of a customer profile at edge, cloud and datacenters/POPs.
Lead proof of concepts end to end: define success criteria, design, hardware specifications, installation, configuration and testing of Quvia systems. Responsible for troubleshooting complex issues with customer, QA and Engineering teams, and own the handoff from POC to production.
Use scripting and DevOps practices to streamline solution delivery – configuration templating, workflow automation and tooling that supports demos, POCs and repeatable deployments.
Act as a technical advisor to customers, offering guidance on best practices and optimal usage of terrestrial and satellite communication systems, and presenting status updates and health metrics to customer stakeholders.
Conduct training sessions and workshops for customers and internal teams on the operation and maintenance of Quvia products and their value proposition.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product management, systems, engineering, QA, and service delivery, to ensure successful project execution. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for all solutions and services provided. Complete a successful handoff to all relevant teams at the end of the project.


What You'll Need


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
At least 5 years of network engineering experience across terrestrial and/or satellite communications, including multi-link architecture.
Deep networking fundamentals, including routing and switching, network security, wireless, and datacenter networking.
Hands-on experience with software-defined networking (SDN) and multi-vendor SD-WAN and Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platforms such as Fortinet, VMware VeloCloud, Cisco (Meraki/Viptela), Cradlepoint (Ericsson), Palo Alto, or similar enterprise solutions.
Scripting and DevOps experience in a networking context – Python, REST APIs, configuration orchestration, zero-touch provisioning and workflow automation.
A track record of leading customer-facing POCs, deployments or migrations (for example, from traditional WAN architectures to SD-WAN) in large enterprise environments.
Proven ability to convert a customer’s current network, new technical requirements and pain points into business outcomes, and to articulate that value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven knowledge and understanding of managing virtual infrastructure using VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, or KVM, and a thorough understanding of computer hardware and operating systems.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to lead customer conversations at both engineering and executive level.
Commercial awareness: the ability to spot opportunities to reduce cost, simplify delivery, and open new market segments through better solution design.
Project management experience and the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
Satellite communication (SATCOM) systems knowledge and experience is a plus.
Experience with cloud-hosted networking and security (e.g. Azure- or AWS-hosted NGFW) is a plus.


What We'll Offer


Competitive Salary
Performance related bonus
Competitive Health Benefits including optical and dental plan
Pension Scheme
30 days Paid Time Off
Paid Public Holidays
Share Options
Monthly phone allowance

Quvia will never ask job applicants or new hires to send money or deposit checks for the company. In case of doubt, please contact us directly at hr-recruitment@quvia.ai
